title: GAX-P08 - MedQAbstain immutable dataset and component-rights qualification
outcome: Freeze the immutable MedQAbstain dataset identity, audit transformed source families and rights separately, verify abstention transformation lineage without hidden-gold leakage, and admit only evidence-supported components under a sealed final-test boundary.
rationale: MedQAbstain is directly relevant to GAX native abstention, but it is derived from multiple medical QA sources with different content and media rights. A dataset-wide code or repository license cannot substitute for component-level provenance and redistribution evidence.
scope_in: Immutable Hugging Face dataset revision and sibling identity probe
Inventory update only to evidence-supported state
scope_out: No GAX or baseline final-test inference
No paid API or founder-paid cloud
No copying of upstream images or raw source datasets into GAX
acceptance: Canonical dependency is SG-000016 closeout main a1432dc81d48407c551b1b8ddefefa478a2cd33f
Research repository is frozen at disi-unibo-nlp/llm-medical-abstention commit 3c296b55686f1bcf3e0eccbdd12bfc57c4bfdd1d
The Hugging Face dataset revision must be obtained from immutable API/Git metadata and must not be guessed as main
Sibling files and LFS/content identities are frozen metadata-only
Dataset-card license metadata is recorded exactly as published
MedXpertQA text, MedXpertQA multimodal, MedMCQA, MedQA 4-option, MedQA 5-option, and AfriMedQA are audited separately
Image/media rights are classified separately from text rights
The transformed gold target cannot be created unless the original correct option is absent from the model-visible action set
Default paper role is final-test-only unless an independent prospective development surface is proven before model comparison
Exact and preregistered normalized near-duplicate/source-overlap audits are metadata-only
Public-pretraining contamination remains unresolved and disclosed
At closeout each required component is qualified or blocked rather than indefinitely ambiguous
Overall P08 final-test access remains sealed
Exact-head Linux/Windows Python 3.11/3.12 CI and the dedicated MedQAbstain qualification workflow pass before merge
Implementation merge uses expected_head_sha and post-main qualification succeeds
A separate canonical closeout is required before SG-000017 becomes PROVEN

risk.recovery: Revert SG-000017 files and keep MedQAbstain blocked. Final-test access remains sealed and no model result is generated in this grain.

observed_outcome.blocked_reason: The immutable derived dataset exposes no license grant and exact source-generation revisions/media rights are not sufficiently established for paper-required use.

qualification: 11,215 construction-eligible rows and 17 quarantined anomalies recorded
five exact visible duplicate pairs and 1,264 preregistered near-duplicate pairs disclosed
aggregate MedQAbstain paper use remains blocked because the immutable derived dataset exposes no license grant
final-test performance remained sealed and P08 authorization remained false
